content:
TL;DR: I expected autoParam default values in structures to not be relied upon by the Inhabited derived instances to populate the values of fields

Pre-v4.30 the following snippet worked, while in the latest stable version it gives an error.
MWE

structure Foo where
  prop : Nat := by assumption
  deriving Inhabited

example (n : Nat) : Foo := { : Foo}

I'm not sure if this change in behaviour is deliberate or not, but it seems to have been introduced by the rework in lean4#9815 of the deriving handler. It looks like the deriving handler is executing the autoParam's tactic script to derive the default value of the field, and a failure in the tactic script results in a failure of the deriving instance.

I argue that one wants the prior behaviour, for instance to enable one to write by infer_instance, or as it's my case, by exact q(inferInstance) (whose default should moraly be Lean.instInhabitedExpr.default)

Ok, looking at the PR further it seems to be a known limitation judjing by this comment. I would like to provide the prior usecase in favour of supporting this though (and by this I mean switching to the default way of deriving an inhabitant if the tactic script of the autoParam fails to provide a value)
